lyrics.text: Sun on my face, I'm out the door
Shoes in my hand, feet on the floor
City behind me, getting small
I don't look back, not at all
Wind in my hair, heart in the sound
Laughing like I got no doubt
I lost the map, I found the spark
We chase the day into the dark
No more waiting, no more chains
I'm not living in yesterday
Turn the lights down, feel the bass
Let the whole world fade away
I run wild, I feel alive
No goodbye, just open sky
I run free, I'm finally me
No gravity, just you and me
Run wild, run wild, run wild
Hands up, heart loud
Run wild, run wild, run wild
Lost but so found
Moon on the street, stars in my eyes
We don't need a reason why

Anywhere the night can go

If I fall, I fall in style
If I'm scared, I run wild
